The best-supported referent in Ramagundam is 'Chilkalayya Gudi (Ramalayam)' at 4-2-42/2, SH1, Annapoorna Colony, Jyothi Nagar, Ramagundam 505208 (onefivenine listing; meta.ai place listing gives the coordinates below; Justdial lists it at 4.5-4.6 rating, Annapoorna Colony Jyothi Nagar) - identity certainty MEDIUM: the CSV row could equally intend the Bugga Ramaswamy Temple (listed in Ramagundam, pincode 505187) or another small Ramalayam. town_description: Ramagundam is an industrial town in Peddapalli district on the Godavari, built around the NTPC thermal power station, the FCI fertilizer plant and Singareni coal mines. Jyothi Nagar is one of its residential colonies off State Highway 1.
